profile.headline: Software & Systems Engineering | Anti-Tamper | MBA | Computer Engineering
profile.summary: Multiple years of experience in the defense sector.  Strong experience with integration and test with Radar and EW systems.  Experience leading teams and engaging customers.  Growing experience in the Anti-Tamper industry. Growing experience in SW development with focus in C++ and C#, and WFM.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Totowa, New Jersey, United States · On-site

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Totowa, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Mission Data File Generator (MDFG) Suite
Contributing member of 4-person team to design and implement MDFG tool suite with Plugin architecture and automated testing.  MDFG was built using Microsoft's WFP Framework with C#, XAML, and the MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel) software architectural pattern.  

Responsibilities:
Designed MDFG requirements based on customer needs
Designed plugin-based framework for WPF application
Enhanced user experience with GUI library UI for WFP by Telerik
Used Scrum Agile SW Dev lifecycle for project developments and team coordination

Tools: Visual Studio 2017, Git, Bitbucket, JIRA
Programming Languages: C++, C#, WPF XAML

In-Country Reprogramming IRAD
Member of a 4-person team to research, design, and prototype a new product feature for an existing product line for international sales.  The feature would allow global customers to generate their own Mission Data Files. This end product required added security and a simplified user interface.

Responsibilities:
Provide SME AT knowledge to the product line for MDFG
Design front-end user interface for a foreign customer
Prototype proof of concept to upper management with novel microprocessor

Tools: Visual Studio 2017, VxWorks, WPF
Programming Languages: C++, C#, WPF, XAML

Microprocessor SW Testing Suite
... Details available later.

positions.title: Senior Systems Engineer
positions.description:
•Design security architectures based on requirements from your analysis of adversary threats and proposed countermeasures
• Implement and test security countermeasures according to the guidance provided by the U.S. Government
• Work with Security State of the Art (S-SOTA) technologies
• Provide our customers with sophisticated, defense-in-depth security solutions
• Demonstrated experience in various portions of the Systems Engineering lifecycle.
• Experience performing formal verification testing of complex designs.
• Laboratory experience with instrumentation, equipment and processes.
• Systems Security Engineering experience with an emphasis on Anti-Tamper Techniques and Technologies.
• Motivated individual with the ability to work in a fast paced environment.
• Experience leading formal test events with customer involvement.
• Experience with NIST/FIPs compliant cryptography and cryptographic algorithms.
• Experience with defining attack vectors.
• Experience identifying security countermeasures

positions.title: System Engineer II
positions.description:
	Active Security Clearance
	Performs technical planning, systems integration, verification and validation
	Evaluates cost, risks, supportability and analyses for total systems
	Analyzes all levels of total system product including concept, design, fabrication, test, installation, operation, maintenance and disposal.
	Ensures logical systematic conversion of product requirements
	Translates customer requirements into hardware/software specifications

positions.title: Associate engineer Member staff
positions.description:
Test and evaluate for Aegis and radar programs. Assist with planning, implementing, and reporting on Systems Integration and Test (SI&T) activities. Perform system-level integration and verification of system level requirements. Conduct System Level testing of complex computer programs in a lab and ship or site environment. Perform data analysis to evaluate, document, troubleshoot, and correct system/element computer program anomalies.
Support requirement verification test procedures and test reports as required by the supporting program.
Support the program technical leadership and functional management on cost, schedule and technical performance.
Work closely U.S. Government customer and customer representatives in all of the above tasks.

positions.title: Lead Math Instructor
positions.description: Teach multiple students at one time. Conceptualizefundamental math concepts in different ways. Identify under developed mathskills among students.Manage and manage fellow math instructors. Provide contructive feedback for management to streamline data input and teaching methods. Promoted to Lead Math Instructor in 2015.

positions.title: HP - Printer Sales Expert
positions.description: Make sure printers are clean, organized and demonstration ready. Interact with customers and answer any questions regarding the HP printers, attend weekly conference calls, complete monthly online training, train Best Buy Sales associates. NJ Sales District was #1 in the nation for attachment of HP Instant Ink.

positions.title: Violin Teacher
positions.description: Teach students violin basics and some music theory. Help improve memorization skills.

positions.title: Senior Part Time Receptionist
positions.description: Perform administrative duties under time restraints.Create calendars using Microsoft Publisher. Organize appointments for parishioners. File important documents. Promoted to senior worker in June 2012.

positions.title: Sales Representative
positions.description: Scheduled appointments with customers and sold fine cutlery and kitchen products. Consistently met sales quota. Publicly spoke and individually trained to new recruits. Developed professional etiquette. Successfully reached goals in team environment. Achieved top 10 sales representative for two months
